text: C: combines shared software with your private overlay.
Mount removable media using the DOS Prompt menu.
Sign in to save your changes to the server.
TYPE C:\SOFTWARE.TXT lists installed programs and launch commands.
Each game is in its own subdirectory.
TYPE C:\SOFTWARE.TXT lists game launch commands.
Read the original licence and documentation in each package.

software_catalog: Change directory, then run the named program.

sources.title: Open Watcom C/C++ 1.9

text: ECHO Open Watcom C/C++ environment ready.
int main(void) { puts("Hello from Open Watcom C!"); return 0; }

sources.license: Sybase Open Watcom Public License 1.0; original LICENSE.TXT and DOS extender licence retained. Official FreeDOS package from Open Watcom.
sources.description: Compile 16-bit and 32-bit DOS C/C++ programs with WCL or WCL386. Includes DOS libraries, headers, compiler help and a small Hello World example; START sets the build environment.

sources.title: Open Watcom Fortran 1.9

text: ECHO Open Watcom Fortran environment ready.

sources.license: Sybase Open Watcom Public License 1.0; original compiler and DOS extender licence notices retained.
sources.description: Build numerical and scientific DOS programs in Fortran 77 using WFL or WFL386. Includes DOS runtime libraries, language help and a compile-ready example; START selects this compiler's environment.

sources.title: Free Pascal 1.0.10

text: ECHO Free Pascal environment ready. Try: FPC HELLO.PAS
ECHO Run FP for the text-mode IDE.

sources.license: GPL compiler with runtime library licence exceptions; original licence texts retained in DOC/FPC. Original upstream release from the Free Pascal project's SourceForge archive.
sources.description: Compile Turbo Pascal and Object Pascal code into 32-bit DOS programs with a period-appropriate compiler. Includes the FP text IDE, runtime/FCL units, GNU assembler/linker and a Hello World example.

sources.title: FreeBASIC 1.10.1

text: ECHO FreeBASIC environment ready. Try: FBC HELLO.BAS

sources.license: GPL-2.0 compiler with runtime library exceptions; complete FreeDOS package including original documentation, licences and SOURCE/FBC/SOURCES.ZIP.
sources.description: Compile BASIC into native 32-bit DOS programs, with QuickBASIC-compatible language mode and graphics libraries. Includes headers, libraries, original examples and source archive; START makes FBC available.

sources.title: NASM 3.02

text: ECHO NASM environment ready. Try: NASM -f bin HELLO.ASM -o HELLO.COM

sources.license: BSD-2-Clause; complete official FreeDOS package including licence, manual, DOS DPMI runtime and supplied source archive.
sources.description: Assemble x86 code into COM binaries or object files using NASM, and inspect machine code with NDISASM. Includes the manual, DOS runtime and a tiny Hello World COM example.

sources.title: JWasm 2.18

text: ECHO MASM-compatible assembler ready. Run JWASMR for help.

sources.license: Sybase Open Watcom Public License 1.0; complete FreeDOS package with original licence, sample assembly programs and supplied source archive.
sources.description: Assemble MASM-style source for 16-bit and 32-bit DOS targets. Offers real-mode JWASMR and protected-mode JWASMD, example programs and the original documentation.

sources.title: DJGPP C/C++ + RHIDE

text: Temporary compiler files. Keep this directory available.
ECHO DJGPP GCC/C++ environment ready. Try: GCC HELLO.C -o HELLO.EXE
ECHO Run RHIDE for the text-mode IDE.
int main(void) { puts("Hello from DJGPP!"); return 0; }

sources.license: GNU GPL and DJGPP runtime exceptions; original FreeDOS package licence/documentation trees retained. CWSDPMI runtime comes from the official DJGPP archive.
sources.description: Build 32-bit DOS C/C++ programs with GCC 4.7.1, GNU binutils and make, or edit projects in RHIDE 1.5. Includes the DJGPP environment, C/C++ libraries, DPMI runtime and an example.

sources.title: Microsoft Word 5.5 for DOS
sources.license: Original Microsoft download of Word 5.5 for DOS; proprietary, not open source. Original readme and release information retained; no Windows or OS/2 installation is included.
sources.description: Write formatted documents in Microsoft's DOS word processor with pull-down menus, styles, spell-checking and a thesaurus. British English edition, prepared for VGA text mode without running interactive Setup.

sources.title: As-Easy-As 5.7

text: The publisher discontinued this product and released free full licences.
Original copyright and distribution notices are retained.

sources.license: TRIUS proprietary freeware release; the publisher's free-licence announcement and original distribution notices are retained. Not public domain or open source.
sources.description: Work with Lotus-compatible WKS/WK1 spreadsheets, formulas, macros, statistical functions and graphs. The publisher's DOS 5.7 release is unpacked directly from its original ARC data archive.

sources.title: Ability Plus 3.0
sources.license: Complete working historical DOS release supplied by Ability Software at https://www.ability.com/en/support/dos; proprietary, not open source. Original help and sample documentation retained.
sources.description: Switch between a word processor, spreadsheet, database, charts and communications in one DOS office suite. Includes the publisher's original AB3 launcher, examples and tutorial files.

sources.title: VisiCalc (IBM PC, 1981)

text: Original Lotus licence: personal, non-commercial use only.
Not public domain; no unrestricted redistribution permission is implied.
Read the original terms before use:

sources.license: Original IBM PC executable released by co-author Dan Bricklin under the Lotus VisiCalc licence for personal, non-commercial use, not public domain or unrestricted redistribution. See https://bricklin.com/history/vclicense.htm; preserved original download.
sources.description: Try the original IBM PC spreadsheet with instant recalculation and slash-key commands. It only sees the current directory; use /SQY to quit and save worksheets into the private C overlay.

sources.title: Calc602
sources.license: Operator-supplied original Software602 runtime, bundled with permission. Original program/help copyright notices retained; not labelled open source.
sources.description: Build spreadsheets with formulas, mathematical functions and graphs in Software602's graphical DOS interface. Includes original help, screen resources, fonts and printer drivers.

sources.title: Vlak 2.01
sources.license: Unlicense for the author's original software; original documentation retained. See https://www.breatharian.eu/sw/vlak/index.html and https://www.breatharian.eu/Panda38/.
sources.description: Steer a growing train through 50 puzzle scenes, collect every object and reach the exit without hitting walls or your wagons. Miroslav Nemecek's DOS game with editable levels.

sources.title: DOS Manažer 2.20
sources.license: Author's freeware release, now Unlicense for his original work. Retains LICENCE.TXT and CTI_MNE.TXT; third-party shareware and installers are not installed. See https://www.breatharian.eu/sw/dosman/index.html.
sources.description: Miroslav Nemecek's file manager, from the author of Vlak: directory comparison, text and hex editing, a spreadsheet, database, calendar and high-precision calculator.

sources.title: Text602 3.1
sources.license: Historical Software602 distribution from https://www.osdos.net/download.htm; original program documentation retained. Copyright remains with its owners; not labelled open source.
sources.description: Write formatted Czech and Slovak documents with multiple open files, spell-check dictionaries, fonts and printer drivers. Includes Text602's original help and sample documents.

sources.title: Manager602 2.0
sources.license: Distributed as freeware by https://www.sosej.cz/Software/Jiny-software/Ostatni/M602; original Software602 copyright and help retained.
sources.description: Copy, move and inspect DOS files in two panels, browse the directory tree and use built-in viewing tools. Czech Software602 manager with its original help and display resources.

sources.title: DOS Navigator 2.14 beta
sources.license: DOS Navigator open-source licence, similar to BSD; original licence, documentation and supplied source archives retained.
sources.description: Manage two directory panels, work with archives and switch between built-in editors, viewers and tools in DOS Navigator's Turbo Vision desktop.

sources.title: DOSZip Commander 2.68
sources.license: GPL-2.0; complete FreeDOS package, licence and supplied source archive retained.
sources.description: Browse two file panels and pack or unpack ZIP archives without leaving the file manager. Includes long-filename support.

sources.title: Thomson-Davis Editor 5.1w
sources.license: Public domain; complete FreeDOS distribution and documentation retained.
sources.description: Edit several text or binary files in separate windows. Use TDER for real-mode DOS, TDEP for protected mode, or TDV to view a file without editing.

sources.title: BIEW / Beye 6.10a
sources.license: GNU GPL; complete FreeDOS package, licence and supplied sources retained.
sources.description: Inspect executable files and edit raw bytes in hexadecimal. This DOS build requires an i686-capable CPU configuration.

sources.title: GrafX2 2.2
sources.license: GPL-2.0; complete FreeDOS package with original licence and supplied source archive.
sources.description: Draw 256-colour bitmap art with brushes, palettes and image effects. A DOS paint workspace rather than a file viewer.

sources.title: DOSMid 0.9.8
sources.license: BSD-2-Clause; complete FreeDOS package, licence, documentation and supplied sources retained.
sources.description: Play MIDI, RIFF MIDI and Doom MUS files from DOS through OPL, MPU-401 or other supported synthesizers.

sources.title: Winter Challenge
sources.license: Commercial DOS game; redistribution requires the operator's permission. Original game files retained.
sources.description: Train or compete in a winter tournament: downhill skiing, biathlon, bobsleigh, ski jumping and skating each need different timing and controls.

sources.title: Summer Challenge
sources.license: Commercial DOS game; redistribution requires the operator's permission. Original game files retained.
sources.description: Compete in summer athletics, cycling and equestrian events, practising individual disciplines or entering a tournament.

sources.title: Lotus: The Ultimate Challenge
sources.license: Commercial DOS game; redistribution requires the operator's permission. Original game files retained.
sources.description: Race Lotus cars through changing weather, create custom tracks and challenge another driver in split-screen arcade races.

sources.title: Duke Nukum (shareware)
sources.license: Original Apogee shareware episode; complete distribution documentation and ordering/licence files retained.
sources.description: Duke's original EGA adventure pits him against Dr. Proton's robots. Explore city levels, collect power-ups and find the exit; shareware episode 1.

sources.title: Duke Nukem II (shareware)
sources.license: Original Apogee shareware episode; complete distribution documentation and ordering/licence files retained.
sources.description: Fight through alien-filled platform levels with stronger weapons and destructible scenery in Duke's sequel; shareware episode 1.

sources.title: Crystal Caves (shareware)
sources.license: Original Apogee shareware episode; complete distribution documentation and ordering/licence files retained.
sources.description: Help Mylo Steamwitz collect every crystal in puzzle-filled mines while avoiding traps and enemies; the first shareware episode.

sources.title: Bio Menace (shareware)
sources.license: Original Apogee shareware episode; complete distribution documentation and ordering/licence files retained.
sources.description: As Snake Logan, rescue hostages and fight mutant creatures in an EGA run-and-gun platform adventure; shareware episode 1.

sources.title: UTILS — DOS archive tools
sources.description: DOS command-line archive toolkit: create ZIP, ARJ and 7-Zip archives; unpack RAR, ARJ, LHA, CAB, TAR, GZIP, BZIP2 and ZOO formats.
post_install: IF NOT EXIST BIN MD BIN
sources.launch: CD \UTILS\BIN then ZIP, UNZIP, UNRAR, UNARJ, ARJ or 7ZA
sources.license: Info-ZIP, GPL/LGPL, public-domain and original UnRAR/UnARJ terms; complete licence documents and provided sources retained. No RAR compressor or registered keys included

sources.title: FreeDOS EDIT
sources.license: FreeDOS EDIT (GPL-2.0); package includes COPYING and source archive
sources.description: Edit AUTOEXEC.BAT, configuration files and source code in FreeDOS's menu-driven text editor.

sources.license: BSD-2-Clause release on the author's site; original copyright, conditions and disclaimer retained as LICENSE.TXT.
sources.description: A small, two-panel DOS file manager for copying, moving and comparing files, with configurable menus and file associations.

sources.title: Norton Commander 4.0
sources.license: Commercial Symantec software; enable only with redistribution permission
sources.description: Original English Norton Commander 4.0 for DOS: two-panel file management, editor, online help and file viewers. Server-side extraction requires no interactive installer.

sources.title: Borland Turbo Pascal 3.02
sources.license: Original Borland/Embarcadero Museum download; historical freeware release, not public domain. All original files retained
sources.description: Write and compile Pascal programs in the early integrated Turbo editor. Includes the original example programs.

sources.title: Borland Turbo Pascal 5.5
sources.license: Original Borland/Embarcadero Museum download; historical freeware release, not public domain. All original files retained
sources.description: Build Object Pascal programs with the Turbo IDE or TPC compiler. Includes object-oriented examples, online help and BGI graphics.

sources.title: Borland Turbo C 2.01
sources.license: Original Borland/Embarcadero Museum download; historical freeware release, not public domain. All original files retained
sources.description: Develop C programs with the TC IDE or TCC command-line compiler. Includes headers, libraries, BGI graphics and sample C programs.

sources.title: Borland Turbo C++ 1.01
sources.license: Original Borland/Embarcadero Museum download; historical freeware release, not public domain. All original files retained
sources.description: Explore early C++ with Borland's IDE and compiler, class libraries, startup sources and example programs.

sources.title: ThunderBYTE 8.03 (evaluation)
sources.license: ESaSS LICENSE.TXT permits free redistribution of the complete, unchanged evaluation package. Not freeware; no registered keys included
sources.notes: Original evaluation utilities and documentation retained without modifications. Historical definitions only; not protection for the host or current malware
sources.description: Historical antivirus evaluation tools for scanning DOS files and investigating old malware. Not protection for today's host system.

sources.title: Norton AntiVirus (Michelangelo)
sources.license: Original free Michelangelo-specific edition distributed by Symantec; complete NAV.EXE/NAV.DAT/NAV.HLP/READ.ME package, not the commercial full version
sources.notes: Historical single-virus tool, not current antivirus protection
sources.description: Symantec's limited Michelangelo-specific scanner, with its original data file and help. Not the full commercial Norton AntiVirus suite.

sources.title: Prince of Persia
sources.description: Escape the palace before time runs out. Precise jumps, traps and sword duels stand between the prince and the princess.

sources.title: Wolfenstein 3D (shareware)
sources.license: Original shareware WL1 episode; retain VENDOR.DOC and ORDER.FRM
sources.description: Explore a Nazi fortress in first person, finding keys, secret rooms and supplies while fighting guards; the original shareware episode.

sources.title: DOOM (shareware episode)
sources.notes: Run SETUP to enable Sound Blaster music and effects (port 220, IRQ 7, DMA 1); the archive's DEFAULT.CFG disables both
sources.license: Original shareware DOOM1.WAD episode, not the registered/commercial WAD
sources.description: Battle demons through the first DOOM episode using weapons, keys and hidden passages. Run SETUP to choose sound hardware.

sources.title: Battle Chess
sources.description: Play chess against the computer or another player, with animated battles whenever a piece is captured.

sources.title: Commander Keen 1 (shareware)
sources.license: Original shareware episode; duplicate root copy excluded, KEEN1.DOC and order files retained
sources.description: Help Billy Blaze recover his spaceship parts on Mars, using a raygun and pogo stick; Commander Keen's first shareware episode.

sources.title: Cannon Fodder
sources.license: Commercial DOS game; redistribution requires the operator's permission. Original package documentation is retained.
sources.description: Lead a small squad through rescue and combat missions. Split teams, use vehicles and explosives, and keep experienced soldiers alive.

sources.title: Cannon Fodder 2
sources.license: Commercial DOS game; redistribution requires the operator's permission. Original package documentation is retained.
sources.description: Command the squad across historical and alien battlefields in the tactical-action sequel. Balance direct shooting with team movement and limited supplies.

sources.title: Commander Keen 2
sources.license: Commercial DOS game; redistribution requires the operator's permission. Original package documentation is retained.
sources.description: Board the Vorticon mothership and disable the weapons aimed at Earth. The second Invasion of the Vorticons episode.

sources.title: Commander Keen 3
sources.license: Commercial DOS game; redistribution requires the operator's permission. Original package documentation is retained.
sources.description: Explore Vorticon VI and confront the Grand Intellect in the final Invasion of the Vorticons episode.

sources.title: Commander Keen 4 (shareware)
sources.license: Original shareware release; original documentation and distribution files retained.
sources.description: Search Gnosticus IV and rescue the eight Oracle Council members in the first Goodbye, Galaxy! episode; shareware.

sources.title: Commander Keen 5
sources.license: Commercial DOS game; redistribution requires the operator's permission. Original package documentation is retained.
sources.description: Infiltrate the Shikadi space station and stop the Omegamatic in the second Goodbye, Galaxy! episode.

sources.title: Commander Keen 6
sources.license: Commercial DOS game; redistribution requires the operator's permission. Original package documentation is retained.
sources.description: Travel across Fribbulus Xax to rescue Keen's babysitter from the Bloogs in the sixth DOS episode.

sources.title: Keen Dreams (shareware)
sources.license: Original shareware release; original documentation and distribution files retained.
sources.description: Escape a vegetable kingdom and defeat Boobus Tuber using flower-power projectiles. The original DOS dream adventure, not a modern remake.

sources.title: Catacomb
sources.license: Commercial DOS game; redistribution requires the operator's permission. Original package documentation is retained.
sources.description: A top-down maze adventure: find keys and treasure, then clear a path through monsters with magical fireballs.

sources.title: Catacomb II
sources.license: Commercial DOS game; redistribution requires the operator's permission. Original package documentation is retained.
sources.description: Return to top-down maze exploration with new rooms, treasure and magical combat in Catacomb's sequel.

sources.title: Catacomb 3-D
sources.license: Commercial DOS game; redistribution requires the operator's permission. Original package documentation is retained.
sources.description: See the catacombs through wizard Petton Everhail's eyes. An early EGA first-person action game with spell-based combat.

sources.title: The Catacomb Abyss (shareware)
sources.license: Original shareware release; original documentation and distribution files retained.
sources.description: Enter graveyards, crypts and catacombs in a first-person fantasy adventure, fighting monsters with magical missiles; shareware.

sources.title: Color Lines
sources.license: Gamos game; deployment administrator confirms permission to provide full versions
sources.description: Place coloured balls into complete lines to clear space. Every move must leave room for the next balls to appear.

sources.title: Lemmings
sources.notes: DOS release from Internet Archive; the BestOldGames archive contains a Windows executable instead
sources.description: Assign workers to dig, climb, build or block paths so that enough lemmings reach the exit without falling into traps.

sources.title: The Lost Vikings
sources.notes: Run the original SETUP first, then VIKINGS; the unconfigured game reports copy protection failure
sources.description: Switch between three Vikings with complementary abilities and guide all of them through each platform puzzle. Run SETUP first.

sources.title: Quadrax
sources.description: Coordinate two explorers to move blocks, operate mechanisms and open a route out of each logic-puzzle room.

sources.title: Supaplex
sources.license: Supaplex package includes SPFIX63 and its documentation; deployment permission confirmed by administrator
sources.description: Guide Murphy through circuit-board mazes, collecting Infotrons while avoiding enemies, falling objects and blocked routes.

sources.title: Tetris
sources.description: Rotate and place falling tetrominoes to complete horizontal lines before the stack reaches the top.

sources.title: The Incredible Machine (demo)
sources.license: Interactive demo, confirmed in TIM/TIM.TXT; this source does not provide the full game
sources.description: Try physics-based construction puzzles by combining everyday objects into working contraptions; an interactive demo.

sources.title: The Incredible Machine 2
sources.description: Solve construction puzzles by arranging machines, gadgets and other objects into chain reactions that complete each task.

sources.title: Formula One Grand Prix
sources.description: MicroProse's Formula One simulator combines car setup, practice sessions and circuit racing rather than arcade-style road driving.

sources.title: Grand Prix 2
sources.description: Drive the cars and circuits of the 1994 Formula One season in MicroProse's successor to Formula One Grand Prix.

sources.title: Ironman Super Off Road
sources.description: Race off-road trucks around compact top-down tracks, taking jumps, collecting upgrades and competing simultaneously.

sources.title: Lamborghini: American Challenge
sources.description: Drive a Lamborghini through arcade road races across American cities and highways.

sources.title: Dungeon Master
sources.description: Guide a party through a first-person dungeon, combining real-time combat, spell casting and environmental puzzles.

sources.title: Dungeon Master 2: Skullkeep
sources.description: Return to party-based dungeon exploration in Skullkeep, solving mechanisms and combining combat with magic.
